create_AnimatedDrawing: create an AnimatedDrawing character from CharacterConfig, RetargetConfig, and MotionConfig to animate a hand-drawn image
update_AnimatedDrawing: call update on an AnimatedDrawing instance to advance its internal clock and recompute mesh vertex positions
create_AnimatedDrawingRig: create an AnimatedDrawingRig from a CharacterConfig to build a 2D skeletal rig for character deformation
set_global_orientations_AnimatedDrawingR: set global joint orientations on an AnimatedDrawingRig using a dictionary of BVH frame orientation angles
generate_mesh_AnimatedDrawing: generate a triangulated 2D mesh from a character mask using Delaunay triangulation and contour approximation
